feedback.worked_solution:
A function $g(x)$ is concave down over an interval $(a,b)$ if ${g}^{″}(x)<0$ for all $x\in (a,b).$

On the given graph of $y={g}^{″}(x),$ we can see that ${g}^{″}(x)<0$ on the intervals $(-6,-4)$ and $(1,5).$ 

Therefore, the function $g(x)$ is concave down on the intervals 

$$
(-6,-4\,)\,\text{and}\,(\,1,5\,).
$$
